prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Calibrate Pet Desktop Space", "Ensure display overlay permissions and multi-monitor coordinates are active before your pet steps onto your screen.", "Desktop overlay layer enabled"]
1: ["Choose Your Pet Personality & Voice", "Energetic Buddy vs Gentle Companion"]
2: ["Try Your First Pet Commands", "Practice calling, hiding, and talking to your new pet right now.", "Practice Voice Call, Practice Hide Shortcut, Practice Mood Reaction"]
3: ["Save Your Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to store your pet's personality, memories, and items permanently."]
4: ["Already adopted a pet before? Sign in with your original email to restore your pet instantly."]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Animation Engine", "Building graphics shaders, window transparency, and custom pet movement paths."]
6: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Choose Instant Adoption for a ready-to-play companion (30s) or Custom Creation to design from scratch (2 mins).", "Continue Choice"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered! Complete setup to unlock an exclusive Founder Pet Toy.", "Bonus Unlocked: Free Founder Toy"]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this app. We will chime when your pet is ready on your screen."]
9: ["Meet Your Screen Companion", "A living desktop pet that plays, listens, and brightens your workspace every day."]

verdicts.problem: Promises free extras or gifts (Free Founder Toy)
